src/guest/elf/index.ts: Linux ELF loader. Loads and initializes the supplied lmctf gamei386.so.glibc, but running it as a Q2 game needs about 25 more libc services (fopen, fgets, sscanf, vsprintf, localtime, rand, strncmp, atan2 ...), a linux-i386 branch in the classic guest source, game selection and the classic guest save format (abi is pinned to windows-i386). Not yet wired.
